text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Symboli Kris S was rehydrating,
but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Today—
I feel like drinking something sweet.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Normally... I don't care for it.
But right now—my body is craving it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Still not enough.
I need... more sugar...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I've heard that craving sugar is a sign of fatigue.
It might be best to review your upcoming race schedule.
